fish.name: Cod
fish.text: The old reliable of cold seas. Salted, it feeds whole villages through the winter.

fish.name: Salmon
fish.text: Born in rivers, grown in the sea, and home again to spawn. Strong for its size.

fish.name: Pufferfish
fish.text: Swells into a spiky ball when it's frightened. Don't eat it raw. Really, don't.

fish.name: Tropical Fish
fish.text: A flicker of colour from the warm reefs. Every one is painted a little differently.

fish.name: Minnow
fish.text: Small, silver and everywhere. Every angler's first catch, and every heron's lunch.

fish.name: Gudgeon
fish.text: A whiskered little bottom-feeder that bites at almost anything.

fish.name: Roach
fish.text: Red-eyed and bony. Old anglers say a roach can count your hooks.

fish.name: Dace
fish.text: Quick as a dart in clear, running water on bright days.

fish.name: Chub
fish.text: A greedy river fish with a mouth like a coin purse. Eats cherries that fall from the bank.

fish.name: Perch
fish.text: Striped and spiny-finned. Where there's one perch there are twenty.

fish.name: Carp
fish.text: A patient pond fish. Monks keep them in stew ponds for Fridays.

fish.name: Tench
fish.text: The doctor fish: folk say a sick fish rubs against a tench to be healed.

fish.name: Bluegill
fish.text: A round little sunfish that guards its nest in the shallows.

fish.name: Whitefish
fish.text: Pale and mild. Northern villages smoke it by the barrel.

fish.name: Tilapia
fish.text: Hardy enough to live in a puddle. Mothers carry their young in their mouths.

fish.name: Crayfish
fish.text: A little freshwater lobster that backs away under stones.

fish.name: Blindfish
fish.text: Born in the dark and never needed eyes. Feels its way along the cave floor.

fish.name: Bream
fish.text: Deep-bodied and slimy. Shoals of bream turn the evening water to bubbles.

fish.name: Pike
fish.text: The freshwater wolf. Waits in the weeds, then strikes like a thrown spear.

fish.name: Brown Trout
fish.text: Spotted gold and red. Rises to a fly at first and last light.

fish.name: Rainbow Trout
fish.text: A pink stripe down its side, like a rainbow caught in a stream.

fish.name: Barbel
fish.text: Four whiskers and a stubborn pull. Hugs the gravel in fast water.

fish.name: River Eel
fish.text: Wriggles across wet meadows on rainy nights. Nobody knows where they're born.

fish.name: Largemouth Bass
fish.text: All mouth and appetite. Has been known to swallow a duckling.

fish.name: Smallmouth Bass
fish.text: Bronze and spirited. Leaps clean out of the water when hooked.

fish.name: Arctic Char
fish.text: Lives in water so cold it aches. Its belly turns red as a winter sunset.

fish.name: Lamprey
fish.text: A jawless thing with a mouth full of rings of teeth. Kings once feasted on lamprey pie.

fish.name: Desert Pupfish
fish.text: A tiny blue fish that survives where nothing should. Plays like a puppy in warm pools.

fish.name: Piranha
fish.text: Teeth like a saw. Mind your fingers when you take the hook out.

fish.name: Bowfin
fish.text: An ancient swamp fish that can gulp air when the water goes stale.

fish.name: Mudskipper
fish.text: A fish that walks on its fins and climbs roots to look around.

fish.name: Stone Loach
fish.text: Hides under pebbles in underground streams and only comes out to eat.

fish.name: Zander
fish.text: Glassy eyes made for the dark. Hunts when the moon is up.

fish.name: Grayling
fish.text: The lady of the stream, with a sail of a fin. Smells faintly of thyme.

fish.name: Catfish
fish.text: Whiskers as long as your arm. Comes up to feed when rain muddies the water.

fish.name: Golden Carp
fish.text: A carp the colour of a crown. Rises at dawn in still, clear water.

fish.name: Burbot
fish.text: The only cod of fresh water. Spawns under the ice in the dead of winter.

fish.name: Arowana
fish.text: Leaps from the water to snatch beetles off low branches.

fish.name: Nile Perch
fish.text: A silver giant of the savanna rivers. Grows as big as a grown man.

fish.name: Snakehead
fish.text: Breathes air and shakes off hooks in storms. Swamp folk call it the snake that swims.

fish.name: Swamp Gar
fish.text: A long beak full of needles and scales like armour. Older than the swamp itself.

fish.name: Glow Minnow
fish.text: A minnow that shines like a lantern in the deep dark pools.

fish.name: Oasis Tetra
fish.text: A jewel of a fish found only in desert pools. Blink and it's gone.

fish.name: Sturgeon
fish.text: A great armoured fish with a snout like a shovel. Its eggs fetch a king's ransom.

fish.name: Ghost Catfish
fish.text: So pale you can see its bones. Lives in the black water below the world.

fish.name: Herring
fish.text: Swims in shoals of thousands. Pickled, salted, smoked: herring keeps a coast alive.

fish.name: Sardine
fish.text: A little oily silver fish, best packed tight and grilled on a fire.

fish.name: Anchovy
fish.text: Tiny, salty and strong-tasting. A spoonful flavours a whole pot.

fish.name: Mackerel
fish.text: Striped like the sea on a windy day. Fights hard for its size.

fish.name: Grey Mullet
fish.text: Cruises river mouths sipping at the mud. Notoriously fussy about bait.

fish.name: Pollock
fish.text: A cold-water cod cousin that hunts in packs.

fish.name: Sea Bream
fish.text: A silver-pink fish with a gold band between its eyes.

fish.name: Shore Crab
fish.text: Scuttles sideways and pinches anything it doesn't like. That's most things.

fish.name: Shrimp
fish.text: See-through and twitchy. Comes up to the light at night.

fish.name: Sea Cucumber
fish.text: Not a cucumber. Not quite a fish. Mostly a lump that sits on the sea bed.

fish.name: Arctic Cod
fish.text: A small cod with antifreeze in its blood, at home under the ice.

fish.name: Sea Bass
fish.text: The wolf of the sea. Hunts the surf when the tide turns.

fish.name: Haddock
fish.text: A dark thumbprint on each side, from a saint's hand, the fishwives say.

fish.name: Flounder
fish.text: Lies flat in the sand with both eyes on one side, waiting.

fish.name: Red Snapper
fish.text: Red as a rose and snappish with it. Bites best in a warm rain.

fish.name: Conger Eel
fish.text: A huge grey eel that lives in shipwrecks. Strong enough to pull a man in.

fish.name: Dogfish
fish.text: A small spotted shark. Its skin is rough enough to sand wood.

fish.name: Lobster
fish.text: Blue-black in the water, red in the pot. Mind both claws.

fish.name: Oyster
fish.text: A rough grey shell with a soft heart. Now and then, a pearl.

fish.name: Moon Jelly
fish.text: A drifting moon of a jellyfish. Beautiful, and not for eating.

fish.name: Halibut
fish.text: The great flatfish. A big one is heavier than the angler who lands it.

fish.name: Bluefin Tuna
fish.text: Built like a cannonball and faster than a horse. It'll take the line to the horizon.

fish.name: Mahi-Mahi
fish.text: Green and gold in the water, it flashes blue the moment it's caught.

fish.name: Monkfish
fish.text: All head and mouth, with a little lure on its brow. Delicious, if you can bear to look.

fish.name: Lionfish
fish.text: A mane of striped, venomous spines. Handle it like a hedgehog made of nettles.

fish.name: Octopus
fish.text: Clever enough to unscrew a jar. Holds on to the sea bed with all eight arms.

fish.name: Stingray
fish.text: Glides over the sand like a cloak in the wind. Keep clear of the tail.

fish.name: Swordfish
fish.text: Its bill is a real sword. It leaps, it spins, it will not give up.

fish.name: Blue Shark
fish.text: A long blue shark that follows boats in rough weather.

fish.name: Anglerfish
fish.text: Fishes for its supper with a glowing lure. Tonight you fished for it.

fish.name: Old Whiskers
fish.text: A catfish older than the village bell. The miller's grandfather swore it took his dog.

fish.name: Sunscale
fish.text: A fish of hammered gold that rises at noon in the desert pools when the sun is fiercest.

fish.name: The River King
fish.text: A silver giant that rules the savanna rivers. Lions are said to drink upstream of it.

fish.name: Rimefin
fish.text: A pike of living ice, seen through frozen lakes on still, starry winter nights.

fish.name: Old Mossback
fish.text: A sturgeon so old that moss grows on its back. Moves up the taiga rivers in the autumn rains.

fish.name: Stormjaw
fish.text: A great shark that hunts the open sea under thunderstorms. Sailors pray never to see its fin.

fish.name: The Bog Lantern
fish.text: The light in the marsh that leads travellers astray is no spirit: it's the lure of this fish.

fish.name: Deepglow
fish.text: A blind white eel that glows blue in the black water at the bottom of the world.

fish.name: Jade Arowana
fish.text: A dragon of a fish with jade scales. Jungle folk say it leaps for the rain itself.
